description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI' for managing employee attendance records within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, and deleting attendance records, along with validation rules and permission checks. The class interacts with attendance data models, DAO, and service traits, and utilizes API documentation annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI integration.
